people.name: Kiyozawa Manshi (清沢 満之)
people.field: Shin Buddhist thinker, academic and reformer

relations.subject: Kiyozawa Manshi (清沢 満之)
relations.evidence: he studied Western philosophy under the American philosopher Ernest Fenollosa.

relations.subject: Kiyozawa Manshi (清沢 満之)
relations.evidence: Kiyozawa was instrumental to the establishment of Shinshū University in Tokyo in 1901... Kiyozawa served as the first dean of the university.

relations.subject: Akegarasu Haya
relations.evidence: Many Higashi Hongan-ji scholars trace their line of thought to Kiyozawa Manshi, including such men as Akegarasu Haya (1877–1954)

relations.subject: Kurube Shin'yū
relations.evidence: the Dobokai movement (同朋会運動), a reform group formed in 1947 composed of many disciples of Kiyozawa, including Kurube Shin'yū.
